<action type="say">
Here’s how to do this on REI’s site using the guest-order lookup (with the email/ZIP you gave) and choosing an in‑person drop‑off.

1) Go to REI’s order lookup
- Open rei.com.
- At the top, look for “Account” or your name and also “Orders” or “Order status.”
- Click “Order status” (or “Orders” → then look for a link like “Track order” or “Order lookup”).

2) Switch to the guest-order lookup
On the order-status / order-history page you should see two areas:
- One showing orders for your signed‑in account.
- Another link or section for orders placed as a guest or with a different email, labeled something like:
  - “Find a single order”
  - “Look up an order”
  - “Track a guest order”

Click that guest / single‑order lookup option.

3) Enter the guest-order details
In the guest lookup form, enter:
- Email: chris.bakker@rockytrailguides.com
- Shipping ZIP code: 80202
- If they ask for last 4 digits of the card, enter: 8934
Then submit the form. It should load that guest order.

4) Open the order and start a return
Once you see the order summary:
- Click the order number or “View details.”
- On the order‑details page, look for:
  - “Return items”, “Start a return”, or “Return or exchange items.”
- Click that to begin the return.

5) Select the Winter Jacket and quantity
On the “Select items to return” screen:
- Find the line for “Winter Jacket.”
- Check the box next to it.
- Make sure the quantity is set to 1 (if more than one was purchased).
- Click “Continue” or “Next.”

6) Choose the reason
On the reason screen:
- Pick the closest option to “Does not fit / Wrong size / Size or fit issue.”
- If there’s a notes box, you can add: “Doesn’t fit right in the shoulders.”
- Continue to the next step.

7) Choose in‑person drop‑off
On the return method screen, you’ll see options like:
- Mail‑in with a prepaid label, and
- Drop‑off / in‑store / in‑person.

Select the option that clearly indicates in‑person or store drop‑off, such as:
- “Drop off at REI store”
- “In‑store return”
Then:
- If asked, confirm or search for a location near ZIP 80202 and select the store/location you want.
- Click “Continue” / “Next.”

8) Review and confirm
You’ll see a summary:
- Item: Winter Jacket
- Quantity: 1
- Return method: In‑person / drop‑off at [chosen location]
- Refund: amount and method (should say refund to original payment method ending in 8934, or similar).

If everything looks good, click the final button (e.g., “Submit return” or “Confirm return”).

9) Save your return info
After confirming:
- Note any return/confirmation number shown.
- Save or screenshot any QR code / barcode they give you.
- Check for a confirmation email sent to chris.bakker@rockytrailguides.com.

10) At the drop‑off location
Bring:
- The Winter Jacket (with tags if possible).
- The QR code / barcode or confirmation details (on your phone or printed).
- The card ending in 8934 if they want to verify it.

If you tell me exactly what text you see on any screen (e.g., the labels of the buttons on your Order Status page), I can give you “click this, then that” instructions tailored to what you’re seeing right now.</action>
